messages:
marie: Heads up — CI red on the hosted integration suite after the infra deploy. Multiple failures around auth token exchange and streaming/tool-call tests. Anyone oncall?
marie: Failing tests: auth_v2_flow.test_token_refresh, stream_tool_integration.test_tool_invoke_timeout
marie: Quick log:
```
error: 401 Unauthorized from https://hosted-api.internal/v1/sessions
payload: {"error":"invalid_client"}
```
alex: I can pick this up. Does a straight rerun change anything?
ci-bot: Build 78342 failed on tests: auth_v2_flow, stream_tool_integration. Rerun available: https://ci/78342/retry
kevin: Noticed this started after the credentials rotation yesterday. Are the tests using the old test client secrets?
sara: We rotated client secrets for hosted-test yesterday at 03:00 UTC. Staging and CI should have been updated but let me confirm.
marie: @sara can you check test vault entries for `hosted-test-client`?
sara: Checking now. ETA 2m.
ci-bot: Rerun requested by @alex
marie: Rerun queued.
devops-bot: New deploy completed at 1832507810 — nginx proxy updated to include stricter header validation (x-internal-auth required). May affect auth header parsing.
alex: That proxy change would reject older test clients that don't set x-internal-auth. Either revert the patch on test infra or update tests to include the header. Fastest short-term: revert on CI.
kevin: Can someone bisect quickly? Re-run the last green build (78310) against the new infra to see if it fails. If it breaks, it's infra-change related.
sara: Secrets were missing for one of the test clients — pushing updated secret to vault now.
marie: Devs, heads-up: if header validation is the cause we should avoid sweeping reverts. Try secrets + rerun first.
ci-bot: Re-run started (requested by @alex).
marie: Rerun finished — still failing but error changed:
```
error: 422 Unprocessable Entity from streaming endpoint
body: {"error":"unsupported_schema","details":"tool_call schema mismatch"}
```
alex: That looks like the hosted-api schema enforcement kicked in for tool calls. Did the schema bump land recently?
kevin: Which PR bumped the tool_call schema? @alice was involved in that change.
sara: Alice is OOO today. I can scan the commit log for schema changes. Stand by.
alex: Quick workaround: flip tool schema enforcement off for the CI namespace while we triage. Config: `/etc/hosted-api/config/enforce_tool_schema: true -> false` (target only ci-hosted-namespace).
marie: Can we target only the CI/test namespace? Don't want to disable globally.
devops-bot: Flag toggle applied to `ci-hosted-namespace` at 1832508045 by @sara
marie: Re-running pipeline again now that secrets + flag changed.
ci-bot: Re-run started.
marie: Tests passing now — all integration tests green (8/8) ✅
sara: Nice. Follow-up: we shouldn't keep enforcement off long-term. Need coordinated rollout: update test fixtures to match new schema + add header assertion tests.
kevin: Filing a follow-up ticket to follow through: https://tickets/INFR-9123 (include bisect notes & logs).
alex: Also add a small regression test that asserts `x-internal-auth` presence so proxy changes break loudly in PRs.
marie: Summary notes for the ticket: initial regressions caused by (1) proxy header validation change and (2) schema bump; immediate mitigation was toggle enforcement for CI + update secrets; next steps = update test fixtures, add header test, revert toggle after patch. I'll attach logs.
sara: I'll open a draft PR to update the test client fixtures and coordinate deployment to test infra by EOD.
marie: Thanks all — great fast triage. :thumbsup:
alex: :rocket:
ci-bot: Build 78342 rerun succeeded at 1832508175
